summary: Annaly Capital Management filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026, under Items 8.01 and 9.01, disclosing that it posted its third-quarter 2026 financial supplement on the Investors section of its website; the supplement is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and covers the quarter ended September 30, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is stated. This is a routine quarterly investor supplement furnishing by the mortgage REIT, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle is none, with attention limited to portfolio and book-value disclosures.
